subject: general
question: In a group of five children (K, L, O, M, N) with different heights, K is the tallest while L is the shortest. O is the second shortest person in that group. M is taller than N. Who among them is the third tallest?
solution:
According to the given information:-

1) K is the tallest while L is the shortest.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2fff32b84a53dd2a1338fc1ed8e3334901bd354c12ede543d6f7de33b5598d7e.png] 

2) O is the second shortest person in that group.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b56ff2c6d1d1322b9459730f50551dc03ff57e3d3b0805e468c73ce3af91123.png] 

3) M is taller than N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d52a4d56a77d1402abab9d1cee4e7af3be096f6368da415bb981c176fcb3ab1.png] 

∴ Here, 'N' is third tallest in the given group.

Hence, the correct answer is **"N".**
